status.evidence:
The LAD also prohibits housing discrimination  based
on the source of lawful income or source of lawful rent
or mortgage payment a tenant or purchaser uses.
status.note: The document presents the rule as current law, with no effective date given.

coverage.evidence:
The rental of a single apartment or flat in a two-family
dwelling, the other occupancy unit of which is occupied
by the owner as his/her residence at the time of such
rentals;
coverage.note: The owner-occupied two-family exemption supports a 2-unit figure. The document also exempts rooms rented in an owner-occupied one-family dwelling and other exemptions. It does not state the exemption applies to source-of-income specifically, and it names no construction or certificate-of-occupancy cutoffs.

citation.evidence:

Law Against Discrimination.
citation.note: The citation names the LAD generally, which the document names. It gives no section number.
